title: Biological Data Science with R: Essential Statistics 8.3.2-8.7
summary: Five connected source-faithful notebooks restore the Wilcoxon, regression, categorical-data, power, model-tidying, and closing study-design sequence over the exact BDSR NHANES data, with all four analytical figures generated by BioLang.

source.title: Biological Data Science with R - Essential statistics
source.note: Adapted for the non-commercial BioLang lesson registry under CC BY-NC 4.0. The exact source-hosted NHANES teaching data are checksum-pinned and downloaded on demand. All analytical figures are generated at runtime by BioLang; no published figure image is copied. Mosaic geometry preserves the source analysis while categorical response colours improve Studio legibility. The lesson preserves the source's White logistic-regression baseline and R power.t.test default tail convention.

datasets.title: NHANES resampled teaching data
datasets.citation: CDC NHANES; resampled teaching extract distributed with Biological Data Science with R
datasets.rights: Source-hosted and downloaded on demand; not redistributed.

lessons.title: 8.3.2-8.3.3 Wilcoxon and Linear Models
lessons.summary: Reproduce the AlcoholYear histogram and Wilcoxon test, then show the equality of the two-group t-test, ANOVA, and indicator regression.

problems: compare skewed alcohol-use observations
show equivalence of two-group mean models

lessons.title: 8.3.6 Multiple Regression
lessons.summary: Fit the source's nested testosterone models for physical activity, age, and gender over the exact complete adult observations.

problems: adjust testosterone associations for age and gender

lessons.title: 8.4 Categorical Data
lessons.summary: Reproduce the gender-diabetes and race-insurance tables, tests, base-R-style mosaics, and White-reference logistic models.

problems: test association between gender and diabetes
model insurance status from race age and income

lessons.title: 8.5 Power and Sample Size
lessons.summary: Reproduce every published t-test and proportion power calculation, including the gene-expression and GWAS exercises.

problems: calculate statistical power
plan sample size for gene expression and GWAS

lessons.title: 8.6-8.7 Tidying Models and Study Design
lessons.summary: Expose tidy coefficient and model summaries, regenerate the source residuals-versus-fitted plot for males, and retain the closing guidance on batch effects and replication.

problems: extract reusable model results
inspect residuals from a multiple regression
distinguish biological sample size from technical measurements
